title: ooRexx Foreign Runtime engineering sphere continuity records

records.rule: Current qualified ABI-specific profile: linux-x86_64-le-lp64 only.
i8/u8/i16/... keep exact width; host aliases resolve separately from compiled ABI.
ForeignBuffer can own or borrow storage; provider release occurs only after pins are released.
Managed pointer fields retain child relationships; transitive graph pinned on call; cycles rejected.
Resident Python proxy arguments are passed by registry reference, including kwargs/dict/nested arrays.
Rexx-facing at/[] is one-based; pythonAt preserves exact Python indexing; mapping keys are supported.
Capsules remain inside provider; ooRexx sees ForeignTensor metadata/operations, not capsule objects.
Descriptor device metadata does not grant CPU dereference permission.
No CUDA runtime qualification; Vulkan hardware path remains optional/host-specific.
